description: Create a Business Central record from `fields` (API v2.0 names): customers/vendors/items/contacts (displayName required, e.g. {"displayName":"Beispiel GmbH","email":"info@example.com"}) or a DRAFT document — salesQuotes, salesOrders, salesInvoices (customerNumber or customerId), purchaseOrders, purchaseInvoices (vendorNumber or vendorId) — with optional `lines` ([{"lineType":"Item","lineObjectNumber":"1896-S","quantity":2}]). Header fields: sales documents customerNumber, externalDocumentNumber, orderDate/documentDate/invoiceDate, requestedDeliveryDate; purchaseInvoices ONLY vendorNumber, vendorInvoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate (no externalDocumentNumber, no description); customers/vendors/contacts displayName, addressLine1, city, postalCode, country, email, phoneNumber. Line fields: lineType, lineObjectNumber, quantity, description, unitPrice (sales) or unitCost (purchase, net). Unknown field names are rejected by Business Central (HTTP 400). Checks for a DUPLICATE first (name/e-mail; externalDocumentNumber; vendorInvoiceNumber per vendor) and returns it as a question — set allow_duplicate only after a human confirmed. Never posts. WRITES into the customer's ERP — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a matching entry already exists

company.description: company name or id; default: the company set on the connection (or the only one)

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's Business Central connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: create_business_central_record
